name: mailviewer
description: A local-only email viewer. Your messages never leave your browser.

scripts.test:print: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.print.config.ts
scripts.release:preview: npm test && npm run test:print && wrangler versions upload --preview-alias staging --message "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
scripts.deploy:
printf '
  Use: npm run release:preview  ->  verify the preview URL  ->  npm run release:promote
  See DEPLOYMENT.md §8.

' && exit 1
